text: Additionally, individuals who request appeals and waivers must perform a variety of activities. text: New applicants, renewals and replacement cardholders who elect to pick up their TWIC card in person, are asked to complete a short, optional electronic customer satisfaction survey about the card issuance process (2.5 minutes or .042 hours).
